maddeler.e:
أنتعش (form VIII)
# أَنْتَعِشُ (ʔantaʕišu) /ʔan.ta.ʕi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
# أَنْتَعِشَ (ʔantaʕiša) /ʔan.ta.ʕi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
# أَنْتَعِشْ (ʔantaʕiš) /ʔan.ta.ʕiʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
